thread:
ana: FYI AWS marketplace PM wants hourly aggregated usage CSVs in PST by product_code. They currently ingest event-level usage (UTC) — reconciliation gap showing ~0.5% duplicate records. Need plan for snapshot export + backfill.
mike: duplicated records from late-arriving events? do we have idempotency keys on marketplace webhook?
ana: we add event_id dedupe when ingesting but partner replays with different event_id sometimes (they change request_id). root cause: throttled retries from their side. :grimacing:
sylvia: ok. propose we produce hourly snapshots (rounded to the hour in PST) with aggregation keys: customer_id, billing_product_code, hour_start, usage_units. that'll avoid replay dupes.
mike: sample SQL for aggregation:
```sql
SELECT customer_id, product_code, date_trunc('hour', (timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles') AS pst_hour, sum(units) AS total_units
FROM usage_events
WHERE timestamp >= '2025-01-01'
GROUP BY 1,2,3;
```
ana: looks good. need to preserve source_event_ids for audit in case partner disputes.
sylvia: agree. add hash of (event_id||source) as dedupe_key and include counts & earliest_event_ts in snapshot.
priyam: what's the backfill window? partner expects 30 days of historical snapshots to start.
ana: they asked for 90 days but we negotiated to 30. so 30 day backfill + daily incremental snapshots from there.
mike: backfill plan: run parquet export per day, run aggregation job, and ship to S3 bucket with prefix partner_name/YYYY/MM/DD/hour=HH/
ana: permissions question: do we create partner-specific S3 creds or they pull via signed URLs?
sylvia: prefer signed URLs for now. limit exposure. marketplace-bot: Failed to deliver webhook to https://marketplace.aws/redwood/usage (status 429) — retrying in 60s.
ana: that 429 aligns with their throttling. we'll include a note in runbook: apply 5% overage tolerance when reconciling usage, but keep audit log of raw events.
priyam: can we add a reconciliation job that matches snapshots against raw events and emits delta report? useful for partner ops.
mike: yes. job steps: load snapshot, load raw for window, left-join, generate rows with discrepancy_type = MISSING | DUPLICATE | SURPLUS, and attach examples for ops.
sylvia: also need timezone edge case test: DST transitions for PST/PDT. create tests for days with 23/25 hours.
ana: good call. I'll own tests + runbook. mike take backfill, sylvia take signed url + schema, priyam build delta report. ETA EOD Thursday?
mike: EOD Thursday works. I'll start the backfill pipeline PR.
sylvia: I'll post schema to #integrations after PR.
priyam: tagging @marketplace-eng for visibility once we have sample files. :thumbsup: 
ana: thanks team. I'll update partner and set tentative sync for Friday 10am PST.
